visual_identity.core_identity: A nearly transparent cube-shaped dungeon ooze whose straight corridor-filling edges and suspended debris make its body readable.
visual_identity.silhouette: Large rectangular cube occupying most of a passage, with subtly rippling edges and a flat forward face.
visual_identity.body_shape: Uniform gelatinous cube with faint internal bubbles and objects suspended at different depths.
visual_identity.surface: Mostly clear open white interior with only sparse contour ripples and bubbles.

scene_identity.natural_posture: Cube fully contacts floor and is constrained by nearby corridor geometry; never floating.
behavior_style: engulfing one or two simple objects

accuracy_checks: objects appear inside rather than in front

known_failure_modes.correction: keep only a few large suspended objects and mostly open interior
